messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert: spike in 5xx and 429s for APAC regional lane · auto-pager sent to #incidents and @oncall
Ava Lee: on it, paging @Joel (oncall) — I'm seeing a sudden ramp in request volume to apac-1, tail latency spikes >800ms, a lot of economy-tier 429s.
Joel (oncall): ack. grabbing logs + current routing snapshot. can someone verify if any deploys hit apac-1 in the last 10m?
Benji Patel: no deploys from infra in the last 30m. looks like traffic pattern shifted — big ingress from a partner org (partner-id: partner-88).
Carmen Ruiz: partner-88 bursted due to a batch job, they weren't rate-limited by our quota window. we should triage by steering and a temporary quota adjustment for enterprise customers only.
Ava Lee: agree. mitigation plan: 1) immediate economy-lane gating (throttle economy to 25% of baseline) 2) steer new sessions from APAC to us-east-2 if latency budget allows 3) temporary +20% quota for enterprise customers affected (partner-88) so customer-facing requests don't error. 4) monitor for errorfallthrough.
Benji Patel: can we do (1) and (2) without a full config rollout? i can apply a policy patch at the router level.
Carmen Ruiz: yes, use the smart-routing hotpatch path. policy snippet:
```
PATCH /api/v1/routing/policies/hotpatch
{
  "match": {"region": "apac-1", "tier": "economy"},
  "action": {"weight": 0.25, "fallback_region": "us-east-2", "max_concurrent": 150}
}
```
Benji Patel: applying now -> `rb-hotpatch-1924680000` (pid 4321).
deploy-bot: hotpatch rb-hotpatch-1924680000 accepted, rollout starting, trace=tr-9c8f. will report completion.
Ava Lee: starting steering probe: run small percentage traffic to us-east-2 and measure latency/throughput. if >2xx success, increase steer.
Joel (oncall): I'm running the impact query in logs: `count(status_code in (429,5xx)) by region, tier, 1m` — APAC economy 429s peaked at 3k/min, higher than usual. enterprise customers (tier=enterprise) had <1% errors.
Carmen Ruiz: good. therefore apply enterprise quota bump for partner-88 only. Benji, can you carve that in the quota service?
Benji Patel: doing quota change: `POST /api/v1/quotas/adjust` payload: `{ "principal": "partner-88", "delta_pct": 20, "expires_in": "15m" }` -> success. change id q-1924680000-1.
Ava Lee: steering probe results: initial 10% showed 2xx rate improved, p95 latency at us-east-2 ~ 210ms. increasing steer to 60% for new sessions.
deploy-bot: rb-hotpatch-1924680000 -> 60% complete, no errors in config application.
Joel (oncall): checking customer impact report: a small set of low-tier customers saw user-facing timeouts; we've gated economy so that should reduce. enterprise partner-88 backed off with quota bump.
Carmen Ruiz: alerting -> inform partner success team to reach out to partner-88 for rate-smoothing recommendations. also file a policy: need tighter default partner quotas to avoid noisy-neighbor next time.
Ava Lee: metric dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/apac/latency?from=now-30m - watching errors and queue length. set a monitor to fire if apac economy 5xx > 300/min for 5m.
Benji Patel: monitor created id m-1924680000-1. also added a short-circuit: if apac queue depth > 2000, disable economy-serving in apac-1 entirely (failsafe).
incident-bot: note: short-circuit configured (id sc-1924680000) — ops runbook updated.
Ava Lee: customer impact summary for SRE/CS handoff: ~150k requests impacted for economy in APAC over 20m window, temporary 429s reduced by 85% after steering + gating. enterprise customers unaffected after quota tweak. action items: (A) postmortem owner Carmen Ruiz, (B) partner outreach Benji, (C) policy follow-up Ava.
Joel (oncall): handing over to day SRE, I'll keep watching for 30m then demobilize if stable. oncall->day-sre handoff: status=stabilized, mitigation=steer+gate+quota-bump, next-check=30m.
Ava Lee: thanks team. leaving a checklist in the incident doc and adding a runbook note to tighten partner defaults.
Carmen Ruiz: creating the postmortem doc now and linking follow-ups.
incident-bot: Pager cleared: incident state -> MONITORING. If errors re-appear, re-escalate.
Ava Lee: closing thread: all mitigations in place, follow-ups assigned. :white_check_mark:
